notes.title: Catch Cylinder Puzzles Returned in the Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We are excited to be in Steam's Couch Co-Op Sale event next week! From Feb 10-17 you can grab Cylinder: Puzzles Returned for 30% off (the biggest discount yet).  ː2015hollyː

You can also check out the demo which features full multiplayer and remote play! ːsteamhappyː

So grab some firends and grab some Cylinder Puzzles for a guaranteed good time. Thanks for the support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781243/36755f2588e07f0eef27f47f398e71a641e0374f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Character Available! Play as Marty from Saturday Morning RPG!
notes.notes:
We are excited to add a new character to the game! Marty from Saturday Morning RPG is now available to unlock along with new skins and a new background! We have also added Language Select to the options so you can change languages in game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781243/998c024277e049e2beecc005f7123c85e899ec5b.png[/img]

Marty brings some fun nods and audio from Saturday Morning RPG and we are stoked to bring him from our old game to our new one. 

We also wanted to adress feedback and make it easier for everyone to change language, we hope you enjoy it! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for oct 21
notes.notes:
New character and content added! Change language in-game! Bug Fixes!

[list]
[*] New character added. Marty from Saturday Morning RPG is available with several unlocks
[*] New background, tile set and song have been added from the previous release of Cylinder
[*] Language select added to options menu
[*] Photosensitivity warning added when starting game
[*] Fixes around online disconnects and controller disconnects
[*] Fixed bug related to online scores getting out of sync
[*] Fixed UI issues when language is set to Korean or Russian 
[*] Fixed issue where selecting opponents to attack would also rotate tiles
[*] Fixed overlay integration when pausing in  multiplayer games
[/list]

notes.title: New Character Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Coming soon on 10-21-25! 

We are proud to have a new update that adds a beloved character from a beloved Mighty Rabbit Studios game!

It will be a fun new addition to the game with some fun nods to the past. Check it out next week!

notes.title: Available Now! Cylinder: Puzzles Returned Has Launched!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone! We are excited to announce the release of Cylinder: Puzzles Returned! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

It is available now for purchase! We'll be broadcasting the game to celebrate so please check it all out.

We'll also be streaming on Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mightyrabbitgames]https://www.twitch.tv/mightyrabbitgames[/url]

Note that the non-English languages will be patched-in soon, we sincerely apologize to our non-English speaking players out there. ːsteamsadː

Thanks for the support, hopefully we'll see you online!

notes.title: Demo Is Available!
notes.notes:
Heyo Everyone!

We are excited to release our demo, now available to download. It's ready ahead of the Next Fest debut, and it features a sample of our Adventure Mode single player content.

Learn the basics, solve the clever single screen puzzles and try to overcome the fun challenges we have in store!

This is a good taste of things to come in the full release; good luck solving these logic puzzles! ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamhappyː
